title: PC-Fairness: A Unified Framework for Measuring Causality-based Fairness
reasoning: The paper's entire focus is on developing a technical framework to measure and bound different notions of fairness in machine learning. Fairness is a core ethical principle, and the work is dedicated to operationalizing this principle to prevent discrimination based on protected attributes. This goes beyond a superficial 'ethical considerations' section and constitutes a deep engagement with an ethical problem through a technical lens.
